# Roava Digital

> Roava Digital is a local SEO and lead generation agency for roofing, gutter, siding, window, and exterior coating contractors in the Roanoke, Virginia MSA. Founded by DeShea Witcher. One operator, one market. No account managers, no generalist playbooks.

## About

- [About Roava Digital](https://roavadigital.com/about): DeShea Witcher, founder. 15 years of B2B marketing applied to Roanoke-area exterior contractors. Background in enterprise software marketing. Serves roofing, gutter, siding, window, and exterior coating contractors exclusively.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://roavadigital.com/services): Full list of services offered. Local SEO, web design, Google Ads, and trade-specific marketing for exterior contractors in the Roanoke MSA.
- [Roofing SEO](https://roavadigital.com/services/roofing-seo): Local SEO built for Roanoke roofing contractors. Google Business Profile management, citation building, location-specific service pages, review velocity strategy. Ranking movement typically visible in 60 to 90 days.
- [Local SEO](https://roavadigital.com/services/local-seo): Local search foundation for any exterior contractor. Covers GBP optimization, citation management, location pages, and review strategy across the Roanoke MSA.
- [Web Design](https://roavadigital.com/services/web-design): Conversion-focused contractor websites. Fast, mobile-first, built to generate calls and form submissions. Under 2-second mobile load time target.
- [Google Ads](https://roavadigital.com/services/google-ads): Google Search Ads and Local Services Ads management for roofing and exterior contractors. Storm-responsive bidding. Transparent reporting. No long-term contracts.
- [Gutter Marketing](https://roavadigital.com/services/gutter-marketing): Local SEO and lead generation for gutter contractors in the Roanoke MSA. Seasonal demand strategy, GBP optimization, dedicated service pages.
- [Siding Marketing](https://roavadigital.com/services/siding-marketing): Local SEO and Google Ads for siding and exterior cladding contractors. Insurance claim pages, material-specific content, storm demand strategy.
- [Window Installer Marketing](https://roavadigital.com/services/window-installer-marketing): Local SEO and paid lead generation for window installation companies in the Roanoke area.
- [Exterior Coating Marketing](https://roavadigital.com/services/exterior-coating-marketing): Lead generation for exterior painting and protective coating contractors, including ceramic and nano-coating specialists.

## Service Locations

- [Locations Overview](https://roavadigital.com/locations): Roava serves contractors across the Roanoke MSA and New River Valley. Each location has its own local pack, competitor set, and search patterns.
- [Roanoke, VA](https://roavadigital.com/locations/roanoke): Primary market. Roanoke City and Roanoke County. Highest concentration of roofing and exterior contractor work in the MSA. Metro population 315K+.
- [Salem, VA](https://roavadigital.com/locations/salem): Independent city with its own local pack. Salem contractors compete against Roanoke-based companies that have expanded service areas.
- [Vinton, VA](https://roavadigital.com/locations/vinton): Roanoke County's largest town. Dense residential neighborhoods and concentrated contractor market.
- [Botetourt County, VA](https://roavadigital.com/locations/botetourt-county): Growing residential area north of Roanoke. Higher-income demographics, newer housing stock, strong demand for exterior work.
- [Bedford County, VA](https://roavadigital.com/locations/bedford-county): Southwest of Roanoke. Lower contractor density means less competition for local pack positions.
- [New River Valley, VA](https://roavadigital.com/locations/new-river-valley): Christiansburg, Blacksburg, and Radford. Separate market from Roanoke with its own local pack and distinct search patterns.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://roavadigital.com/pricing): Flat-rate monthly retainers. Foundation $1,200/month, Growth $2,400/month, Saturation $4,000/month. No setup fees, no hidden costs, no long-term contracts.

## Company

Roava Digital serves roofing, gutter, siding, window, and exterior coating contractors in the Roanoke, Virginia metropolitan area only. Service area includes Roanoke City, Roanoke County, Salem, Vinton, Botetourt County, Bedford County, and the New River Valley (Christiansburg, Blacksburg, Radford). All work is done by the founder. No account managers. No offshore execution.
